title: Stories of Care and Recovery
subtitle: Hear from our patients as they share their journeys of recovery, care, and renewed independence.

items.name: Mohamed Al Menhali
items.quote: With the help of God, and then Cambridge Hospital, I was able to return to my normal life, stronger and more determined than ever.

items.name: Mohamed Al Bloushi
items.quote: Thank God, I was able to get back to walking within almost four months, with God’s will and the help of the team at Cambridge Hospital.

items.name: Tamam’s Mother
items.quote: We are truly grateful for the significant improvements we have observed in Tamam’s communication abilities over time.

items.name: Shamma’s Mother
items.quote: Shamma’s ability to communicate improved remarkably thanks to Cambridge Hospital, and we are deeply grateful.

items.name: Salem Bin Saleh
items.quote: Previously, my daughter would walk three or four steps and then fall. Now, thank God, she walks without relying on anyone, covering thirty to forty metres.

items.name: Nujood Saeed
items.quote: I recommend that anyone facing a medical problem always hold on to hope and never lose faith in recovery, even during difficult times.
